## Independent reviewer recovery steps

First review Prompt 07 using its existing handoff:

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run ci
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/command-rules.test.ts
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short
```

Pass is not by itself acceptance. The independent owner/reviewer must also record Prompt 07's reviewed commit, evidence path, approver identity, and `ACCEPTED` status. After that record exists, Prompt 08 can be resumed from a clean tree and its full negative suite must be executed.
